aboutMe.description: I am a **Lecturer** in Computer Science & Engineering at **World University of Bangladesh**, with a strong passion for academic excellence and research innovation. My professional journey encompasses both teaching and research, focusing on **Artificial Intelligence** and **Natural Language Processing**. Through my academic work and published research in international conferences, I am committed to fostering the next generation of technology leaders while advancing knowledge in cutting-edge fields. I believe in the transformative power of education and strive to inspire students to achieve excellence in their academic and professional pursuits.
quickPreviews: **Current Position:** Lecturer at **World University of Bangladesh**, Department of Computer Science & Engineering
**Academic Background:** B.Sc. in CSE from **Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology** with **CGPA: 3.75/4.00**
**Research Portfolio:** 3 publications in international conferences covering AI, NLP, Fake News Detection & Sign Language Recognition
**Recognition:** National Champion in Hackathon 2022 & Top 15 Female STEM talent in Bangladesh
